name: Eggless Tres Leches Cake
steps: Heat oven to 175°C. Whisk yogurt, sugar, oil, vanilla and 60 ml milk; fold in flour, baking powder and soda.
Bake in a greased 18 cm dish for 25–30 minutes until a skewer comes out clean; cool until just warm.
Mix condensed milk, evaporated milk and remaining milk; prick the cake all over and pour the mixture slowly.
Chill for 4 hours to absorb the milk; whip cold cream to soft peaks and spread over the cake before serving.
tips: Pour the milk in stages; stop briefly if it pools and let the cake absorb it.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
